in_hebrew.name: Margarete
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Margarete הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from 'Margaritis', which means pearl in Greek, Margarete is a name that symbolizes purity and beauty, evoking the image of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who was often referred to as the 'Pearl of the Sea' or the 'Mother of Pearls'.
